failure_class: A remote transaction is falsely advertised as atomic
root_invariant: Atomicity is limited to the actual commit authority and protocol
proposed_treatment: Reject transaction claims spanning unsupported authorities; require a workflow contract

failure_class: Cache identity omits an output-determining input
root_invariant: Equivalent cache keys imply equivalent permitted responses for the declared freshness model
proposed_treatment: Derive key from audience, parameters and tracked environmental dependencies

failure_class: Read tracking misses absence, range or predicate dependencies
root_invariant: Changes capable of changing a query result invalidate it even when no prior row was read
proposed_treatment: Record negative reads, ranges, indexes and membership; fall back conservatively when incomplete

failure_class: External writers bypass the invalidation authority
root_invariant: Freshness guarantees cover every allowed write path
proposed_treatment: Declare write authority coverage; use CDC or weaken freshness explicitly

failure_class: Cached computation depends on untracked time, locale or configuration
root_invariant: Every changing input has a revision, bounded expiry or explicit noncacheable status
proposed_treatment: Make locale, policy, feature flags, time buckets and external revisions dependencies

failure_class: Independently fresh fragments form an incoherent page
root_invariant: Related observations meet the declared consistency cut, not only individual TTLs
proposed_treatment: Carry revision/causal constraints across resource and fragment boundaries

failure_class: Error or negative result is cached as durable success
root_invariant: Cacheability and expiry apply to each outcome, not just value type
proposed_treatment: Separate missing, unauthorized, transient failure and stale success; derive response directives

failure_class: HTTP validator refers to the wrong representation or audience
root_invariant: A validator certifies the selected representation within its key and authorization context
proposed_treatment: Derive ETags and conditional responses from exact materialization identity

failure_class: Fine-grained invalidation claims completeness without proof
root_invariant: Precision is an optimization; coverage of all result-changing inputs is the correctness obligation
proposed_treatment: Attach dependency-coverage status; incomplete knowledge triggers broad invalidation or stated staleness

failure_class: Regeneration publishes a partial or failed replacement
root_invariant: Materialization publication is atomic and validates its complete identity and policy
proposed_treatment: Stage then publish; preserve previous authorized result only when staleness policy allows

failure_class: Browser storage is treated as guaranteed durable storage
root_invariant: Local acknowledgement states the durability actually obtained
proposed_treatment: Distinguish in-memory, locally committed and server-committed state; expose eviction/recovery

failure_class: Offline merge converges but violates product meaning
root_invariant: Convergence is separate from preserving domain invariants and user intent
proposed_treatment: Offer proven merge families and explicit validation; never universal last-write-wins

failure_class: Deleted objects reappear after delayed replica replay
root_invariant: Deletion knowledge cannot be discarded while an admitted replica may resurrect state
proposed_treatment: Define replica expiry and required reset before tombstone garbage collection

failure_class: Multiple tabs independently perform singleton background work
root_invariant: Singleton work is coordinated across the intended ownership domain
proposed_treatment: Coordinate across tabs/workers and fence stale leaders; idempotency remains required

failure_class: Local database upgrade blocks forever on old clients
root_invariant: Schema upgrade must account for every live connection and incompatible client
proposed_treatment: Close or park owned connections, preserve pending drafts and expose blocked upgrade

failure_class: Wall-clock timestamps are mistaken for causal order
root_invariant: Ordering evidence must match the promised consistency, not assume clocks agree
proposed_treatment: Use authority-issued revisions for commits and explicit merge order for replicas

failure_class: Offline queue replays under a new user, schema or expired intent
root_invariant: Queued intent retains its original identity, contract and validity conditions
proposed_treatment: Validate principal, policy, schema and expiry on replay; migrate or reject explicitly

failure_class: Connectivity indicator is interpreted as successful synchronization
root_invariant: Network presence, server reachability and replication convergence are distinct states
proposed_treatment: Report connecting, authenticated, catching-up, current and failed as applicable

failure_class: Browser parser repairs markup into a different tree
root_invariant: Compiler document structure must agree with browser parsing in its insertion context
proposed_treatment: Validate nesting/namespaces and compare parsed DOM, including table and SVG contexts

failure_class: Environment-dependent initial state disagrees across targets
root_invariant: Initial document, serialized state and code share compatible inputs
proposed_treatment: Capture needed locale/time/random values once or explicitly defer them

failure_class: Template identity is confused with a live instance address
root_invariant: Definition identity and instance identity cannot be interchangeable
proposed_treatment: Keep existing identity-domain/instance/local-part decomposition

failure_class: Keyed update reuses identity for a different semantic item
root_invariant: A retained UI identity continues to denote the same item within its domain
proposed_treatment: Require identity for mutable lists; detect duplicate runtime keys and refuse ambiguous patch

failure_class: Patch sequence is partly applied before validation fails
root_invariant: A patch transaction is validated and committed without exposing an invalid partial document
proposed_treatment: Preflight addresses, versions and structural constraints; rollback or resnapshot on failure

failure_class: Resumption executes handler against incompatible captured state
root_invariant: Handler, schema, audience and document revision must be jointly admissible
proposed_treatment: Preserve existing checks; extend durable compatibility under T01

failure_class: External DOM mutation breaks exclusive renderer assumptions
root_invariant: The renderer must define ownership and recovery when the browser or external code changes DOM
proposed_treatment: Distinguish owned nodes from external islands; detect broken anchors and recover without silently destroying edits

failure_class: Portals or shadow roots lose event, style or accessibility relationships
root_invariant: Logical ownership, DOM ancestry and composed event paths are different relations
proposed_treatment: Represent physical placement separately from scope and semantic relationships

failure_class: Text and attribute source representation leaks into output meaning
root_invariant: Authored text meaning survives parsing, lowering, escaping and emission
proposed_treatment: Separate source spelling from decoded value; test whitespace and accessible names end-to-end

failure_class: Asynchronous state update overwrites an unfinished native edit
root_invariant: Draft text and selection are not interchangeable with committed domain value
proposed_treatment: Model editing state separately; merge server updates without resetting active draft

failure_class: Composition text is treated as a completed user edit
root_invariant: Preedit/composition and committed text have different transition semantics
proposed_treatment: Generate composition-aware bindings; defer commit-dependent actions appropriately

failure_class: Lazy handler misses event-dispatch-only obligations
root_invariant: Default prevention and transient event data access occur in the required dispatch phase
proposed_treatment: Infer a minimal synchronous prelude and capture safe transient data before delayed work

failure_class: Activation-gated operation runs after activation expires or is consumed
root_invariant: Permission to act can be a transient browser condition, not a serializable value
proposed_treatment: Classify activation requirements; eager/minimal path where needed; explicit unavailable outcome

failure_class: Updates unexpectedly move focus or selection
root_invariant: Unrelated updates preserve active user interaction identity
proposed_treatment: Preserve focus, selection and caret; explicit focus transition only when user task changes

failure_class: SPA routing destroys link, history or scroll semantics
root_invariant: Navigation retains URL, history entry, scroll and native link affordances
proposed_treatment: Derive routing and fallback; test modified clicks, anchors, back/forward and restoration

failure_class: Enhanced and non-JS forms invoke different business contracts
root_invariant: Every submission transport decodes and authorizes the same command intent
proposed_treatment: Generate form decoder, error mapping and enhanced transport from one command input

failure_class: Frozen or discarded page is treated as an ordinary unmount
root_invariant: Freeze, restore, hidden, terminated and remounted states are distinct
proposed_treatment: Pause/revalidate resources on restore; persist critical intent before termination; do not promise final cleanup on kill

failure_class: Autofill, undo or assistive input bypasses synthetic event assumptions
root_invariant: The native editing surface remains authoritative for supported input mechanisms
proposed_treatment: Reconcile actual control state, undo and autofill; test without keyboard-only assumptions

failure_class: Clipboard or drag payload escapes its authority/lifetime
root_invariant: Transient browser data is decoded and scoped before asynchronous use
proposed_treatment: Capture permitted representations during dispatch, decode untrusted formats and preserve file ownership

failure_class: Accessible name exists but control behavior is absent
root_invariant: Role, name, state and operable behavior form one control contract
proposed_treatment: Prefer native elements; custom controls must implement the complete interaction protocol

failure_class: Pointer interaction has no keyboard or non-drag alternative
root_invariant: Every required operation has an accessible activation path
proposed_treatment: Generate keyboard behavior where determined; require an alternative for custom gestures

failure_class: Modal/popup focus escapes or fails to return meaningfully
root_invariant: Modal ownership controls focus entry, containment and restoration
proposed_treatment: Model invocation and return target; handle deleted opener and nested overlays

failure_class: Async state is invisible or excessively repeated to assistive technology
root_invariant: Important status transitions have an appropriate semantic announcement
proposed_treatment: Derive status from resource state but let product choose urgency and wording

failure_class: Virtualization removes content needed for finding or accessible navigation
root_invariant: Rendering optimization preserves the declared access, search and navigation contract
proposed_treatment: Do not equate smaller DOM with universally better UI; retain or expose complete accessible structure

failure_class: Layout becomes unusable with zoom, contrast or text preferences
root_invariant: Essential content and controls remain usable under supported user preferences
proposed_treatment: Check statically provable token issues and test rendered combinations; preserve user styles

failure_class: Animation ignores motion sensitivity or hides essential state
root_invariant: Motion preferences alter presentation without removing essential information
proposed_treatment: Generate reduced-motion path from animation intent; require an equivalent state indication

failure_class: Media or visual information lacks an equivalent nonvisual representation
root_invariant: Required meaning is available through appropriate alternative modalities
proposed_treatment: Require alternative slots/contracts; humans validate adequacy of descriptions and captions

failure_class: Form failure is announced without actionable field relationships
root_invariant: Validation failures identify affected input and recovery without losing entered values
proposed_treatment: Generate stable label/error associations and summary focus; preserve draft values

failure_class: Geometry reads force pending writes to synchronously lay out
root_invariant: A measurement request states the frame/snapshot it can observe
proposed_treatment: Retain phase rules; test indirect calls and adapter escapes with real traces

failure_class: Resize feedback repeatedly invalidates its own measurement
root_invariant: Observation-triggered writes need a stable convergence or bounded deferred policy
proposed_treatment: Detect self-amplification and bound/defer; explicit fixed-point behavior only when intended

failure_class: A stale geometry snapshot is used as current truth
root_invariant: Geometry is indexed by layout generation and coordinate space
proposed_treatment: Carry snapshot freshness and coordinate system; refresh at legal phase

failure_class: Containment or style elimination changes document semantics
root_invariant: Optimization preserves intrinsic sizing, visibility and accessibility contracts
proposed_treatment: Only add containment/remove rules when proven within the supported style model; otherwise measure or require explicit isolation

failure_class: Intrinsic images/fonts or wrapping produce overflow and shifts
root_invariant: Layout accounts for asynchronous intrinsic size and content-dependent bounds
proposed_treatment: Derive image dimensions where known, preserve wrapping and test long content/font swaps

failure_class: Visual viewport or virtual keyboard obscures active interaction
root_invariant: Layout distinguishes visual viewport, layout viewport and usable input area
proposed_treatment: Centralize keyboard/orientation/viewport lifecycle and test physical devices

failure_class: Animation performs avoidable layout/paint on every frame
root_invariant: Animation mechanism is compatible with declared rendering cost and semantics
proposed_treatment: Select safe properties when equivalent; do not forbid necessary layout animations universally

failure_class: Cascade, global style or print mode invalidates local assumptions
root_invariant: Style ownership must coexist with inheritance, user overrides and media contexts
proposed_treatment: Preserve CSS semantics; record global dependencies and test print/forced-color/embedded contexts

failure_class: Translation is constrained to source-language sentence fragments
root_invariant: Message meaning and parameters are stable while grammar is locale-owned
proposed_treatment: Typed message arguments; locale selects structure/plurals without duplicated application branches

failure_class: Text editing or truncation splits user-perceived characters
root_invariant: Text operation unit is explicit: code unit, code point, grapheme or semantic token
proposed_treatment: Separate indexing APIs and preserve native composition; choose visible-text operations by default

failure_class: Normalization or case folding changes identity unexpectedly
root_invariant: Display equivalence and identifier equality have independently declared authorities
proposed_treatment: Keep stable IDs separate from labels; validate canonicalization at identity boundary

failure_class: Bidi control or direction assumptions misrepresent mixed text
root_invariant: Untrusted text direction cannot accidentally reorder surrounding UI meaning
proposed_treatment: Isolate inserted text, preserve writing modes and make dangerous invisible controls inspectable in tools

failure_class: A date, local appointment and instant are represented by one timestamp type
root_invariant: Time value retains the information required by its domain meaning
proposed_treatment: Distinct Date, LocalDateTime, ZonedDateTime, Instant and monotonic Duration; explicit ambiguous conversion

failure_class: A recurring schedule silently shifts after zone rule changes
root_invariant: Future recurrence states whether local time or exact elapsed time is authoritative
proposed_treatment: Preserve recurrence intent; make rule-update resolution explicit for affected events

failure_class: Formatting is reused as wire or financial representation
root_invariant: Display formatting is not a canonical serialization or rounding authority
proposed_treatment: Separate formatted text from canonical numeric values and domain rounding

failure_class: Pagination order changes under locale or collation updates
root_invariant: A cursor identifies its ordering relation and snapshot assumptions
proposed_treatment: Bind cursor to locale/collation/filter/version or explicitly restart

failure_class: Two protocol parsers disagree on message boundaries
root_invariant: Every hop agrees on the same unambiguous request framing
proposed_treatment: Generate only standards-conformant messages; validate proxy topology and reject ambiguous framing

failure_class: Streaming decoder mistakes chunks for complete messages
root_invariant: Transport chunk boundaries carry no application-message semantics
proposed_treatment: Generate framing/stateful decoding; explicit end/error/truncated states

failure_class: Partial response is accepted or cached as complete
root_invariant: Completeness is independent of successfully received bytes
proposed_treatment: Validate framing/completion before success or cache publication; support ranges only under their contract

failure_class: Declared streaming benefit is defeated by buffering intermediaries
root_invariant: A delivery claim concerns the deployed path, not only application writes
proposed_treatment: Test compression/proxy/CDN buffering and abort propagation through the selected deployment

failure_class: Timeout omits queueing, connection or retry time
root_invariant: End-to-end budget contains all contributing waits and attempts
proposed_treatment: Propagate absolute remaining budget across layers; timeout ownership F06

failure_class: Transport fallback changes application semantics
root_invariant: Equivalent transports preserve ordering, acknowledgement and authorization
proposed_treatment: Run same conformance corpus over SSE, polling, WebSocket or supported WebTransport adapters

failure_class: HTTP method/status/header meaning disagrees with domain outcome
root_invariant: HTTP representation preserves the operation and caching semantics it exposes
proposed_treatment: Derive method, status, redirect and cache headers from typed outcomes; allow explicit external mappings

failure_class: Certificate, DNS or connection assumptions fail outside language control
root_invariant: Connectivity and trust prerequisites are monitored and failure remains representable
proposed_treatment: Test expiry/failure paths, rotate overlap and expose operational dependency; do not promise prevention of all external outages

failure_class: Push source overwhelms a slow consumer
root_invariant: Every stream has a bounded queue or explicit dropping/coalescing policy
proposed_treatment: Propagate demand where possible; bound buffers for WebSocket/SSE/media and disconnect or coalesce by policy

failure_class: Subscription cursor survives after its replay history expires
root_invariant: A resume token either proves continuity or requires explicit resnapshot
proposed_treatment: Detect unavailable history; atomically replace snapshot then resume from its boundary

failure_class: WebRTC peers make conflicting signaling transitions
root_invariant: Signaling state transitions obey one connection protocol under concurrent offers
proposed_treatment: Hide signaling collision/rollback mechanics behind a tested session resource

failure_class: Peer transport readiness is confused with signaling success
root_invariant: Session state distinguishes description negotiation from usable connectivity
proposed_treatment: Expose connecting/degraded/disconnected/failed; retry and relay policy explicit

failure_class: Media capture continues under an unintended destination or obsolete permission
root_invariant: Capture permission does not authorize every recipient or later use
proposed_treatment: Bind active capture to approved recipient/session and stop or reauthorize on change
